label: The device-net bipartite graph
subgoals: Create one vertex per device and one per distinct net
Add one edge per device terminal
Label each edge with its terminal kind

label: Isomorphism and invariants
subgoals: List invariants that any isomorphism preserves
Compare those invariants across the two netlists
Conclude a mismatch when any invariant differs

label: From mismatch to diagnosis
subgoals: Refine both netlists with shared colour names
Find classes whose sizes differ between the netlists
Trace the differing class back to a short, open or swap
